title: AliExpress: 28% Upsized Cashback (New Customers Only), 12% for Existing Customers (Capped at A$50 Per Order) via ShopBack
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 28% Upsized Cashback (New Customers Only), 12% for Existing Customers (Capped at A$50 Per Order) via ShopBack

[JSONBourne] TopCashback is 22% for EXISTING.
That being said we need to maintain competition so we’re not down to 1, can’t ShopBack do any better?
[carrawa] No cashback from sellers from China? AliExpress?
Is there an added comma by mistake?
[tienanbich] lower rate, and failed to track high value items last time (:
[Ironic fear] Yep, only done 2 larger purchases through shopback and had both mysteriously not track.
Bit over a hundred smaller ones all tracked perfectly though, I'm pretty sus of shopback now
[tienanbich] plus my other small/ineligible for cashback orders were still tracked :D
[SuBw00FeR] I've gotten rid of shopback barely works and TC gives way more and tracks heaps better.
[Zodinn] How does ShopBack work, does it work on items that are on sale without using a code?
[GreenGuava] Yes, there's no requirement for you to have to use a code to get a cashback. The main thing is that you click through from ShopBack and the product you buy is from an affiliate seller. You can check by pasting the product URL into this checker .
